info.name: Cafe & Studio C# Local Smoke Tests
info.description: Read-only API and MVC checks. The collection does not create bookings, orders, users, or payments.

exec: pm.test('custom SQLite backend is ready', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'ok', database: 'sqlite' }); });
pm.test('menu endpoint returns an array', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('menu entries include category and price', function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (item) { pm.expect(item).to.have.property('category'); pm.expect(item.price).to.be.a('number'); }); });
pm.test('MVC home page loads', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('page contains Cafe & Studio', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('Cafe & Studio'); });
pm.test('booking page loads', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('จองคิวสตูดิโอ'); });

pm.test('unauthenticated staff page redirects to login', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([302, 303]); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Location')).to.include('/Account/Login'); });
